items.title: Finite matrix composition equality forces orthogonality of profunctor creeds
items.author: Takeshi Tsukada; Kazuyuki Asada; Kengo Hirata
items.source_version: Official published FSCD2026.34,2026-07-15,CC BY4.0 PDF; faithful selected editable transcription on Yupeng2026-10-14
items.difficulty_reason: The author compares numerical division in matrix products with quotienting by the middle-groupoid action. The complete Lemma16 constructs a nonfree orbit from intersecting conjugate stabilizers and makes its cardinality discrepancy strict; Theorem20 transfers that discrepancy through an arbitrary atomic decomposition. The finite-entry proviso is essential to preserve strictness under the sum. This is the paper explicitly identified independent second main conclusion. The matrix functor theorem, supporting orbit lemmas and linear-logic preservation are not separately counted.

primary.label: Original counted Theorem20 creed orthogonality necessity

proof_spans.label: Complete author Lemma16 double-direction orbit cardinality proof and Lemma17 general-case proof
